transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because I've been having some trouble with my eating. On these late work nights, I’ll order what I tell myself is just dinner. But then... it turns into a whole entrée, sides, dessert, and then I end up grabbing extra snacks from my kitchen on top of that. It's just a really large amount of food, way more than I’d ever eat if someone were actually sitting across from me.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Once I start, um, there’s this point where I’m almost just watching myself do it. I'll keep going back to the food or opening another package, and in my head I'm thinking I should stop... but it just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands.
Do these episodes of eating large amounts of food tend to happen when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?

I'm not really sure. I mean, they mostly happen on those late work nights, so I guess there might be some normal work stress going on. But I haven't really noticed feeling specifically anxious or upset right before I start eating. It's more like... I'm just tired and trying to finish up a project, and it just kind of happens.
How do you feel about yourself after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

I'm not really sure. I haven't really stopped to think about exactly how I feel about myself afterward. I mean... I mostly just feel really physically uncomfortable because I ate so much. Since it usually happens on those late work nights, I kind of just throw away all the boxes and wrappers and go straight to bed. I haven't really noticed a specific emotional feeling, just... tired and overly full, I guess.
Do you feel guilty after eating such a large amount of food?

Not really, no. I don't think I feel guilty about it. Like I was just saying, I'm usually so tired by that point that my main focus is just getting the trash out of the way so I can finally go to sleep. I don't really sit there beating myself up over it... it's just more about feeling physically stuffed than feeling bad about myself.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over time due to these eating episodes?

Um, no, not really. I don't weigh myself very often, but... I mean, my clothes still fit the same as they always do. So if my weight has changed, it hasn't been anything significant that I've actually noticed.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during these episodes, or is it more like you're eating automatically?

I definitely don't feel like I'm in control. It's... well, once I start, there's this point where I'm just kind of watching myself do it. I'll keep opening another package or reaching for more, and in my head, I'm thinking that I should really stop... but it just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands. So yeah, I guess it does feel pretty automatic once it gets going.
Do you find that you're eating really quickly during these episodes?

Yeah, I do. I eat really fast. I'll usually be sitting at my desk with my Illustrator files open for work, and I just move from one container to the next. I honestly barely even notice the taste of the food. It's like... I'll just look down and realize I've swallowed most of it in a matter of a few minutes.
Do these episodes of eating large amounts of food happen within a short period of time, like less than 2 hours?

Yeah, it's definitely less than two hours. It usually happens on these late nights when I'm working. I'll order what I tell myself is just dinner, but it always turns into this huge thing—an entrée, a bunch of sides, dessert, and then I'll even grab extra snacks from my own kitchen. It all happens pretty fast, and it's way more food than I'd ever eat if someone were sitting across from me.
Do you ever feel self-critical or experience distress after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed feeling distressed, exactly. I mean... I know it's a lot of food, but right after, I usually just feel really full and tired. I don't really sit there and criticize myself or beat myself up about it, if that's what you mean. I mostly just throw away the containers and try to finish my work, or I just go to sleep.
Do you ever think critically about your body shape or weight after one of these eating episodes?

Not really, no. I mean, I know I've eaten a lot, but I don't really focus on my weight or... or my shape right after. It's honestly just about the physical feeling of being way too full. I don't really look in the mirror or stress over my body like that, I just kind of want the uncomfortable feeling in my stomach to pass so I can finish my work.
Do you ever feel bad about yourself or regret your actions after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

No, I don't really feel bad about myself or regret it. Like I said, I mostly just feel physically uncomfortable because I ate so much. But I don't really sit around feeling guilty or regretting that I did it. I just kind of move on and go to sleep or get back to my designs.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food happen?

Well, when I look back at my delivery receipts and, you know, my calendar... there's usually at least one night every week where this happens. Sometimes more. And that pattern has been going on for several months now.
Do you think these episodes of eating a large amount of food are a problem for you?

I don't really see it as a problem, honestly. I mean, it's just something I do when I'm working late. It makes me physically uncomfortable for a bit, but it doesn't really interfere with my life or anything. I just eat, feel too full, and then get back to what I was doing. So, no, I wouldn't call it a problem.
Have these episodes of eating a large amount of food been happening for more than 3 months?

Yeah, definitely more than three months. It's been going on for about ten months now, actually. It started shortly after I closed on my condo and, you know, began taking on all this extra freelance work.
Do you feel like you have no control over your eating during these episodes?

Yeah, I do. It's like... once I start, there’s this point where I’m almost just watching myself do it. I'll keep going back to the food, or opening another package, and in my head I'm thinking that I really should stop, but... I don't know, it just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands by then.
